visualCharacteristics.purpose: grid of destination or origin tiles with a frozen authored lowest price
traits: bordered rounded tiles with a light shadow
bold label over a "from <price>" line with the amount in bold

contentPattern.structure: 2 columns, one row per tile. Cell 1: optional square image (alt = city name; may be empty). Cell 2: the label as a link to the city/route page (a paragraph, not a heading), followed by an optional price paragraph exactly as rendered on the source with the amount in bold, e.g. "from **454 €**" / "ab **1.488 €**" (frozen authored text; no live price calls, so wording and currency come from the authored content in every locale). No image (empty cell 1 or a single text cell) renders a text-only tile; no link renders a non-clickable tile; extra paragraphs are shown as further price lines. Empty rows are skipped. All tiles show at every width (live .mobile-hidden tiles are not hidden). No label rows; no built-in UI strings

usage: AirCore destination pages (/lhg/{country}/{lang}/dest/cy/*: "From <origin> from <price>" tiles), destination overview (/lhg/{country}/{lang}: square city images with prices), origin and route pages.
reuseGuidance: Use for curated destination/origin tiles with authored prices. For live fares use fare-teaser; for icon shortcut tiles use cards-icon. Prices are frozen at import: re-import to refresh.
